summary: Malaeb full-stack testing: 30/30 backend pytest tests pass covering auth (register/login/me, +961 phone validation, duplicate email 409, invalid admin code 403), RBAC (user->403 on admin routes), fields CRUD (create/list/detail/update/slots), reservations (create pending, clash 409, my/list, admin approve, price persisted), tournaments (create/list/get, join pending, duplicate 409, admin approve team request), admin stats (revenue sums approved reservations). Frontend: auth screen renders with role segmented control (Player/Admin), Phone prefix (+961), EN/AR language toggle. User login routes to /(user) home with Discover, Featured Tournaments, Nearby Fields, and 4 bottom tabs (Home/Fields/Tournaments/Bookings). Admin login routes to /(admin) dashboard with 8 stat cards (Revenue $170, Pending Approvals, Total Bookings, Team Requests, Fields, Tournaments, Players, Approved), Requests link, Create Tournament FAB and 4 tabs (Dashboard/Fields/Requests/Tournaments). All critical testIDs present. Console shows minor non-blocking warnings: expo-notifications web unsupported (expected on web preview), useNativeDriver JS-fallback, props.pointerEvents deprecation.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: Listening to push token changes is not fully supported on web. Expected on web preview. Push notifications need a native build to test — this is non-blocking because backend send_push already fails silently with placeholder key.
Console warning: `useNativeDriver` not supported on web, JS-based fallback used. Cosmetic only; native build will use RCTAnimation.
Deprecation warning: some component uses props.pointerEvents instead of style.pointerEvents. Migrate to style prop to silence.

action_items: (Optional) Migrate props.pointerEvents -> style.pointerEvents to remove deprecation warning.
(Optional) Consider filtering out orphaned TEST_* seed data from prior test runs (currently visible TEST_Arena_Updated in user list because previous cleanup ran only for that run's ids).
Push notifications: cannot be validated end-to-end via web preview; verify on a real Expo dev build.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~530 lines and well organized — under the 700-line threshold; no split needed.
MongoDB _id excluded correctly via projections throughout.
JWT + bcrypt via passlib configured properly; ADMIN_SECRET pulled from env with sensible default.
send_push wrapped in try/except at both reservation and team-request status endpoints so push failure never blocks approval flow — matches PRD requirement.
All routes correctly prefixed with /api; RBAC via require_admin dependency is consistent.
seed_data_creation: Test suite creates and cleans up TEST_Arena field, TEST_Cup tournament, one reservation, and one team request per run via soft-delete.
context_for_next_testing_agent: pytest.ini enforces xdist -n 2 --dist loadscope; keep dependent tests inside a single class (see TestCoreFlow pattern). Backend base URL comes from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Credentials in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Admin code: malaeb-admin-2026.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no failures. Initial run showed 7 failures caused by xdist loadscope splitting dependent test classes across workers; refactored dependent field/reservation/tournament tests into a single TestCoreFlow class so xdist keeps them on one worker. All 30 tests pass thereafter.
